title: Senior HRH Development and Regular Advisor
description: Overview The Senior Human Resources for Health (HRH) Development & Regulation Advisor provides strategic technical leadership, innovation, and quality assurance for all project interventions that strengthen Ethiopia's health workforce across the education-to-practice continuum under RISE and ASCEND HRH activities The Advisor leads implementation of activities to produce competent, practice-ready and continuously learning health workforce while providing technical support to relevant interventions under other project thematic areas that relate to professional regulation, competency assessment, institutional capacity strengthening, digital learning, and knowledge management. The project supports the Government of Ethiopia to strengthen Human Resources for Health (HRH) systems, particularly in underserved and fragile settings where shortages of competent health workers, limited institutional capacity, and weak regulatory systems continue to affect access to quality primary health care. Working through national institutions and decentralized implementation platforms, the project advances sustainable, country-led HRH reforms that improve workforce competency, performance, resilience, and health system effectiveness. Working closely with the Ministry of Health, Ministry of Education, Ethiopian Education and Training Authority (ETA), professional regulatory bodies, higher education institutions, teaching hospitals, professional associations, and development partners, the Advisor will strengthen national systems for competency-based pre-service education, educational quality assurance, accreditation, continuing professional development (CPD), competency assessment, licensing, certification, and professional regulation. The Advisor will also strengthen the institutional capacity of national and subnational HRH stakeholders to sustainably lead education, regulation, accreditation, competency assessment, and professional development functions while promoting country ownership and long-term institutional resilience. The position provides strategic oversight to ensure that all technical interventions reflect national priorities, international best practices, competency-based education principles, implementation science, digital innovation, and the America First Global Health Strategy by producing a competent, resilient, practice-ready health workforce capable of delivering high-quality integrated health services. Position is contingent on MOH and donor guidance. Develop long-term technical strategies, implementation frameworks, standards, operational guidance, and implementation packages. Ensure technical interventions align with national HRH priorities, regulatory reforms, emerging evidence, and global best practices. Lead annual technical planning, work planning, priority setting, and technical budgeting in collaboration with project leadership. Promote adaptive management through routine use of implementation data, stakeholder feedback, and emerging evidence to improve program performance. Lead institutional capacity strengthening initiatives that promote sustainability, country ownership, and transition of HRH interventions to national institutions. Provide overall technical leadership for innovation, implementation science, and continuous quality improvement across the project.
